working_tree_status: Only the hash-pinned new runner is untracked; all ten bound core/test sources match.
scope: Read-only final prelaunch identity and frozen-contract review. No model outputs/FD numbers were inspected, no source edits/builds/tests/models were run.

cotangent_injection.interpretation: Local FP32 addition quantization only; q128 remains fixed by its frozen objective formula.

frozen_execution_contract.upper_chain: Reuse existing actual Fortran FP32 windows through prefix160 output lambda128.
frozen_execution_contract.injection: One rounded FP32 old-lambda plus q128 sum at step128; lower windows chain the actual preceding FP32 return.
frozen_execution_contract.checks: Exact old-baseline checkpoint-prefix comparison before each checked Fortran pullback; all four complete result, 3N counts, finite/admissible published states, RSS and wall limits.
frozen_execution_contract.FD_policy: Separate frozen full-objective and midpoint-increment FD comparisons, per-width shared denominators, plateau, signal floors and one-sided rules; q/eta/thresholds are fixed.
frozen_execution_contract.conditional_diagnostic: At most four extra midpoint-only prefix VJPs, only if the declared initial midpoint-increment check fails and quantization diagnosis is necessary; diagnostic cannot erase failure or trigger retuning.
frozen_execution_contract.execution: Root sole executor; four sequential native prefixes; no rebuild/full-forward/FD/replay run.

result_boundary: This is prelaunch identity readiness only. It makes no claim about the two-time adjoint, FD, or scientific acceptance.
